problem: The preparation-to-qualifier ledger joins only by publication ID, so distinct preparations within a paper inherit every qualifier using that paper. The ledger presents these as applicable endpoint qualifiers without distinguishing related-source context from the actual preparation. CsiR17 includes FLAG-Nac edges094/095; Archaea07 includes E.coli CysQ047–049; C45A/T50C include WT His10 edges055/058–062; recombinant NadK includes endogenous-native qualifiers. K87 also lists paragraph6, which describes2001 metal replacement. The record YAML itself correctly separates these preparations; this is a misleading audit/capture ledger, not a demonstrated incorrect graph endpoint.
